name: Zoila's Sample Room Inc
old_description: Whether you want to start developing your designs or you’re ready to jump into production, Zoila’s Sample Room partners with designers and fashion brands to transform beautiful ideas into custom garments. We work closely with our clients to capture their concepts and ideas, and create one of a kind designs.
about:
Zoila's Sample Room Inc. operates in New York City's Garment Center. Founded in 2005 by Zoila Cruz, the business began after Cruz honed her skills working for notable designers such as Morgane Le Fay, Miguelina, Libertine, and Thakoon. Originally from Ecuador, where she opened her first venture, Cruz established her own sample room to serve both established and emerging fashion brands.

The company provides end-to-end pattern and sample development, including draping, fitting, alterations, and custom orders. It handles production runs ranging from 13 to 200 pieces, working with a wide variety of fabrics — knits, silk chiffon, jersey, netting, denim, wool, leather, fur, sequins, lace, and delicate materials requiring special care. The shop serves as a full-service development partner, taking designs from initial sketches through to finished garments.

Clients include independent designers and fashion labels across the United States, with customers in Miami, Los Angeles, Boston, Washington DC, and upstate New York. Past collaborations involve brands such as those represented by testimonials from Gloria Lee, Jonathan Simkhai, Camilla Staerk, and others, covering runway sample collections, sales-order production, and made-to-measure red-carpet and bridal gowns.

The firm emphasizes deep technical expertise — over 30 years in pattern and sample making — and a hands-on, communicative approach that helps designers move from concept to model-ready pieces quickly, sometimes within a week. Its recognition in the CFDA LatinX Series in 2020 underscores its standing in the industry.
